summary: W3 does not pass round 1. Two done-criteria are only partly met. (1) done 4 / AUD-5: the shared shade-breath swell plays only for enemy ULTIMATES (src/audio/index.ts:1228, slot === 'ult'). tokens.json:369 defines T3 as crowd control, mobility and zones with enemyWindupAudio 'mandatory', and the finding asked for every enemy T3+ wind-up. 18 non-ult abilities are tagged T3 in content/vfx.json and have a 0.1-0.3 s castTime, and 5 more hard-CC casts have wind-ups too. None of them gets the swell. (2) done 3 / AUD-1: the build.py kit gate passes on its own metric, which I reproduced exactly (min 8.35 dB). That metric counts the 25-100 Hz bands, though. On the same metric from 125 Hz up, 21 fighter pairs fall below 8 dB (min 5.11 dB, dunsom/hesmi attack_hit). On the review's own confusability metric (final_audio_tool_confuse.py, 125 Hz-16 kHz), 30 pairs are below 8 dB. A related regression: the new kit attack hits replace the AUD-4-fixed library hits for every fighter auto-attack. Burdam, hesmi, ulkro and lisvel hits lose 3.6-11.4 LU through the review's 220 Hz laptop high-pass (gate <= 3 LU) and carry no contact transient. The build.py impact gate never measures f_*_attack_hit. Everything else holds on fresh runs: both blockers (team-private comms, hidden-tab queue pop at -8.01 dBFS with every other cue silent), the camera listener (a real-client check confirms the ear follows Renderer.listenerFocus()), 0 unbound procs in a 9-min RIFT, ambience on all three maps with the RIFT laning floor 5.1 dB above the music stem, the announcer, the mix, the .m4a pieces, typecheck and content_ids. One harness regression: _harness/probe_audio_listener.mjs exits 1 at its defaults because its seat never dies. I measured done 6 with a copy seated at 2, where burdam died once.

items.evidence: Real Chrome, fresh profile (default settings, muteInBackground on), tab hidden, a real rift_coop ready check. ui_queue_pop is in the cue log and the post-limiter peak is -8.01 dBFS (gate -12) while the master gain stays at 0. Eight ordinary cues (ui_confirm, ui_notify, ui_purchase, ui_level_account, m_level_up, m_takedown, m_announce_major, c_crit) read -999 dBFS hidden. With the UI slider at 0.05 the pop still reads -10.77, and with master at 0 it is silent. Report: _harness/_reports/fw_W3_v1_qpop.json.

probe_audio_team_private (real sim, real engine) for all 9 PingKinds: an enemy ping tries 0 cues, while ally and own pings play m_ping_<kind>, including onMyWay -> m_ping_onmyway. The enemy team's surrender_vote and surrender_failed try 0 cues; your own vote plays m_announce_minor. Code: src/audio/index.ts:1312-1318 (ping gated on by.team === myTeam()) and :1344-1345 (surrender_* gated on e.team === mine). I also checked every 'announce' key the sim emits (src/sim/**). No other team-private key exists, and surrender_passed is silent (:1347). Report: _harness/_reports/fw_W3_v1_team_private.json.

Five sub-criteria hold: `audio/build.py --gates` exits 0. No attack or ult cue is shared (I also hashed every shipped file: 0 duplicate-content groups). Each control kind has its own cue, with c_buff on buffs only. 70 fast cues have >= 3 variants. All 12 paying passives have a proc cue. The >= 8 dB distance passes only on the gate's own metric. I reproduced it exactly in dist4.py (FFT 1/3-octave, 25 Hz-16 kHz, power-normalised, -50 dB floor): min 8.98 / 8.52 / 8.63 / 8.35 dB for swing / hit / ult wind-up / ult release. Several kit cues put most of their energy below 125 Hz (attack_hit: burdam 83 %, hesmi 84 %; swing: burdam 82 %, marund 68 %). On the SAME metric from 125 Hz up, 21 pairs fall below 8 dB: attack_hit 7 pairs (min 5.11, dunsom/hesmi), ult_release 9 (min 6.33, burdam/ilsheta), ult_windup 3 (min 5.50, tunlan/ulkro), swing 2 (min 6.80, marund/tunlan). The review metric that produced the AUD-1 evidence (final_audio_tool_confuse.py: STFT 1/3-octave 125 Hz-16 kHz re max, -40 dB floor) gives, per file, min 2.81 dB (dunsom/hesmi attack_hit) and 30 pairs under 8 dB across the four slots. dunsom/hesmi hits are also close in envelope (3.4 dB). Reports: _harness/_reports/fw_W3_v1_kit_distance_buildmetric.json, fw_W3_v1_kit_distance_reviewmetric.json, fw_W3_v1_kit_distance_reviewmetric_file0.json.
items.fixHint: In audio/build.py kit_gate, measure the identity distance from 125 Hz up, or after the impact gate's 4th-order 220 Hz laptop high-pass, so sub-bass cannot carry the 8 dB. Then re-voice the failing pairs in audio/cues/kits*.py: give each fighter's hit/release a distinct 300 Hz-6 kHz signature (its home material's partials), starting with dunsom/hesmi attack_hit, burdam/lisvel attack_hit, tunlan/ulkro ult_windup and burdam/ilsheta and hesmi/tunlan ult_release. Re-run --gates and dist4.py with the 125 Hz floor until min >= 8 dB.

items.evidence: The first half passes. probe_audio_procs, 9-min RIFT (540 s): 3325 procs, unbound 0, every proc reaches a decision, 0 orphan passive damage; BRIDGE 474 and FRAY 303 also have unbound 0 (_harness/_reports/fw_W3_v1_procs.json). The second half passes for ultimates only. probe_audio_cc: 3 enemy ults in 540 s, the swell tried at the caster 3/3 (1 in earshot, played and panned); S4 a caster 9 m right gives pan 0.45 (_harness/_reports/fw_W3_v1_cc.json). Enemy T3 wind-ups get no swell. src/audio/index.ts:1228 fires enemyUltWindup only when slot === 'ult'. _design/tokens.json:369 defines T3 as 'crowd control, mobility, zones' with enemyWindupAudio 'mandatory'. The finding's fix is 'Apply the shade-breath swell to every enemy T3+ wind-up'. content/vfx.json tags 18 non-ult abilities with castTime > 0 as T3: ardit a1/a2, burdam a1, dunsom a1, ervet a3, hesmi a1/a2, ilsheta a2, lisvel a1/a2, marund a1/a2/a3, nurrow a1, odrum a1, sukri a1, ulkro a2, vashil a1 (castTime 0.1-0.3 s). Hard-CC casts with wind-ups that are not tagged T3 (tunlan a1 fear 0.3 s, tunlan a2 stun 0.25 s, nurrow a2 sleep 0.25 s, nurrow a3 silence 0.15 s, sukri a3 root 0.25 s) also play no allegiance tell. probe_audio_cc's M2 gate checks ults only, so it cannot catch this.
items.fixHint: In src/audio/index.ts case 'cast', also play the swell (or a short-form role, e.g. events.enemyWindup, tail-trimmed to the castTime) when an enemy fighter starts a T3 cast with castTime > 0. Derive T3 from content data at engine build time, never from ids: the ability applies a control status (the sim's CC kinds), has a dash/blink op, or creates a zone; or its present.windupVfx is a T3 vfx. Spatialise it at the caster like the ult swell. Add an M2b gate to _harness/probe_audio_cc.mjs: every enemy T3 cast heard tries the swell at the caster.

Passive damage with no delivery: 226 + 23 + 32 voiced by the same-tick proc, 0 orphans (_harness/_reports/fw_W3_v1_procs.json). The build.py procs gate passes for 16 fighter passives (12 with a payoff) and 39 other triggered passives. Two passives never play their own cue and are recorded as 'cooldown': ironstone_guard_brace, whose sfx c_shield is already voiced by its own shield event, and second_shadow. Both are reasonable.

Done: all 16 fighters have whole f_<fighter>_<slot> kits: 10 slots each, 3 round-robin takes on attacks, a1-a3 and the passive, and 0 duplicate files. probe_audio_kits over 4 seeds x RIFT/FRAY: every kitted attack, hit, a1-a3 cast, wind-up and death resolves to its kit cue; ult releases 24/24 and 25/25 matched with 0 orphans; fighterCall resolves for all 16 (_harness/_reports/fw_W3_v1_kits.json). Not done: (a) the identity-distance margin depends on the sub-125 Hz bands; see done:3 (21 pairs < 8 dB from 125 Hz up; 30 by the review's metric). (b) The fix asked for per-fighter 'casts and impacts', and the finding lists generic projectiles and dashes. Ability impacts still play the shared library hitSfx: c_hit_magic for 9 fighters' abilities, c_hit_phys_heavy for 6, c_slow for 2. Dashes play c_dash for 11 fighters and projectiles c_proj_whoosh for 9. src/audio/index.ts case 'hit' (e.sfx ?? present.hitSfx ?? hitAbility) and case 'dash' never consult a kit. (c) A round-robin take is picked with Math.random (src/audio/index.ts:613), so the same take repeats back to back a third of the time; that is not round-robin.
items.fixHint: Do (a) as in done:3. (b) Add per-fighter impact slots (e.g. f_<fighter>_a1_hit ... a3_hit, ult_hit, and optionally dash) resolved in case 'hit' / 'dash' before present.hitSfx, render them from each fighter's home material, and extend the build.py kit gate to them. (c) Pick a take at random but never the one played last for that cue.
